# PR review instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md), and the canonical
[Autonomio review guideline](../AUTONOMIO_PR_GUIDELINE.md) before review.
Use [Astetik repository specifics](../AUTONOMIO_REPO_SPECIFICS.md) for current
scientific, compatibility, provenance, and documentation boundaries.

The universal guideline owns semantic review; the constitution owns gate laws.
Prepare findings against actual source and CI evidence. Human task authorization
controls posting reviews, requesting reviewers, and resolving remote threads.
The declared approving authority is `mikkokotila`; a checked-in snapshot alone
does not prove live protections or reviewer eligibility.
